component.name: Dolphone
component.summary: Calls and texts for the Flipper One

description.p: Dolphone turns a Flipper One with a cellular modem into a phone: calls over VoLTE, texts, contacts and the call log, with Bluetooth headsets and the 3.5 mm jack. On the Flipper's own screen it runs as FlipCTL apps; in desktop mode this window is the same phone for a monitor, mouse and keyboard.
It is unofficial and not made by Flipper Devices. It is not suitable for emergency calls.
First release: calls, texts, contacts, call log, audio routing and Bluetooth, on the panel and the desktop.
